description: Two-seat Hunter trainer, ex-Royal Netherlands Air Force N-316, retained by the Qatar Emiri Air Force as a static display inside the Doha International Air Base perimeter. It wears the false serial QA04. Not accessible to the public; documented by QEAF enthusiast research and by spottingmode WRO location 20909 with status pre.

Single-seat Hunter mounted on a landscaped plinth near the north-east corner of the former Doha International Airport, about 2.7 km from the QA13 display and inside the same air base perimeter. Qatar's single-seaters were FGA.78s. The individual identity could not be established, so the serial is left blank. An aircraft-shaped object is present on the plinth in Esri World Imagery acquired 27 May 2025.

Westland Whirlwind mounted on a circular plinth about 150 m from the single-seat Hunter, inside the former Doha International Airport perimeter. The Qatar Emiri Air Force operated Whirlwind Series 3 machines from the late 1960s. No serial could be established. A helicopter with visible tail boom and rotor is clearly resolvable on the plinth in Esri World Imagery acquired 27 May 2025.
